text: This book states that the cross (×) polarization of a gravitational wave is the plus (+) polarization rotated by what angle?
explanation: The book says the cross polarization is the plus polarization rotated by 45°, unlike electromagnetic waves whose two polarizations are 90° apart. This 45° relationship is the observable signature of the spin-2 (helicity ±2) nature of the gravitational field. The 90° answer reflects the incorrect electromagnetic analogy.
